audio.text: Morning handover for kennel three, an eight-year-old spayed female Labrador who is one day post op from her G D V surgery. She's on famotidine and maropitant, the morphine C R I was stopped overnight, appetite is still nil, and the plan this morning is to try a dose of Entyce before rounds.

audio.resampling: 24 kHz to 16 kHz by FFT band limiting, see tools/render_samples.py
audio.text: He is such a pro, heart and soul, that the whole clinic trusts him with every case.
audio.note: No drug name is spoken. The words pro, heart sound like the brand ProHeart.
